data.gender_notes: Rohit is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Rohit is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Rohana' which means 'Reddish' or 'Red'. In Hindu mythology, Rohit is the name of a red horse which is considered a symbol of power and strength. The name is believed to bring good fortune and prosperity. The name Rohit carries the meaning “Red, Reddish, Sun” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Rohit usually hope their child will grow to embody red, reddish, sun and live with faith, good character and purpose.
